colors.palette_name: Dual Palette — Cream Olive (Light) & Deep Navy Teal Gold (Dark)
colors.source: الوضع الداكن مستخرج مباشرة من ألوان شعار an9t، والوضع الفاتح هو التصميم الكريمي/الزيتوني المعتمد حاليًا في صفحات الموقع — كلاهما يشتركان بنفس عائلة اللون التفاعلي (تركواز) واللون الثانوي (زيتوني/ذهبي).
forbidden_colors: #00b4d8 (سماوي فاقع قديم، تم استبداله بالتركواز الجديد)
أي hex مكتوب مباشرة داخل className — استخدم الكلاسات الدلالية فقط (bg-background, text-foreground, bg-primary, text-primary, bg-accent, bg-card, border-border, text-muted-foreground)

rules: Headings in Arabic must use Tajawal or Cairo with font-extrabold or font-bold.
English phonetic text or target vocabulary highlights must use monospace or bold Outfit font for clear separation.
Never use Inter for Arabic headlines.

rtl_rules: Root container must have dir='rtl' and lang='ar'.
Use logical Tailwind spacing utilities like ms-* (margin-inline-start) and me-* (margin-inline-end) instead of ml-* and mr-* where directionality matters.
Icons indicating direction (e.g. Next arrow, back arrow) must flip direction when in RTL.
Sidebar and navigation drawer must originate from the right side in RTL mode.
Flex containers with labels and badges must align correctly for RTL text flow.
spacing_and_layout.padding_philosophy: Containers with borders must carry generous inner padding (p-6 or p-8) to avoid collision with text.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-card/80 border border-border shadow-2xl shadow-black/20
visual_enhancers.card_styles: bg-card border border-border rounded-2xl hover:border-primary/50 transition-all duration-300
visual_enhancers.waveform_bar: شريط صوتي متحرك (.wave-bar) بلون var(--brand) — يتبدّل تلقائيًا حسب الوضع

testing_and_data_testid_rules.mandatory_rule: ALL interactive and key informational elements MUST include a clear role-based data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Ensure root HTML has dir='rtl' and lang='ar' set by default.
2. Primary interface text must be in Arabic with high-quality educational tone, while target learning phrases and phonetics are in English.
3. Use Shadcn components for dialogs, tabs, progress bars, selects, and dropdowns — they already read bg-card/bg-popover and adapt to both modes automatically.
4. Ensure audio microphone recording has simulated or Web Speech API fallback with active dynamic wave visuals using the .wave-bar class (no hardcoded color).
5. Include testids on all buttons, forms, audio toggles, and assessment cards.

6. NEVER write a hex color directly in a className (e.g. bg-[#f5f5f3]). Always use the semantic Tailwind tokens: bg-background, text-foreground, bg-card, border-border, bg-primary/text-primary, bg-accent/text-accent, bg-muted/text-muted-foreground. These automatically switch between light and dark.
7. This file (design_guidelines.json) is the single source of truth for the whole project, including the Admin dashboard, for BOTH light and dark modes.

8. Every page/layout that renders at the top level must be wrapped by ThemeProvider (src/context/ThemeContext.jsx) so useTheme()/toggleTheme() is available; the toggle button must appear in the shared Layout header.
